manifest.disk_guard_policy: At least1GiB free before output creation and every regular query/write. On exhaustion, only the existing at-most-once loggerStop/status cleanup may bypass the reserve. fsync failure closes the client; no reconnect.
manifest.native_disk_space: Not verified by local disk guard. Parent reviews native Windows destination capacity separately; no SMB/network capacity probe is implemented.
manifest.sampling_check: Exact readback before configuration, prestart, aboutevery2s and after. No RT/oversampling/acquisition-period setters are allowed. Native header0.5ms still requires post-audit.

capacity_planning_only.basis: Prior1200nominal repeatedly yielded600wall/1200000rows.21600nominal is a new extrapolation, not guaranteed10800wall or fullcycle coverage. Check file headers, continuity and every stage overlap.

manifest.before_start: Five-second observation at -1V/100pA, feedback On/status2, idle and SafeTip Off. Sampled signed current must be >-400pA and <=-25pA. This admits DataLog only.
manifest.after_start: Junction states are observational data. No feedback/bias/scan/position/spectroscopy/protection command exists in this recorder.
manifest.ready_contract: Only after StartACK, fresh native start, elapsed/counter progress, and finite profile readback. Root must check READY plus fresh continuing status/no outcome before a separately audited action.
manifest.disconnect_policy: Readback-verified native Timed duration is the finite fallback. Timeout is not cancellation. No reconnect/repeatedStart; root verifies native UI if stop is unconfirmed.
manifest.file_policy: Native time-series files must be copied and validated separately; status only exposes last path, not every block or its sample array.
manifest.timing_limits: Native start/stop strings are opaque. READY/ACK are client observations, not hardware trigger timestamps. Actual on-time/action overlap and all file content require post-audit.
manifest.known_timing_discrepancy: Prior1200nominal yielded600wall.21600nominal may yield10800wall but actual duration, block continuity and all stage overlap require measurement. No hard trigger alignment or gap-free fullcycle coverage is claimed.
manifest.action_coverage_budget: Use min((21600-nativeElapsed)/2,10800-hostAgeSinceStartClaim); each writer needs its own full finite coverage. This recorder does not authorize or schedule a junction action.
manifest.safe_tip_scope: SafeTip is required Off before Start. The500pA property is recorded but inactive; this passive recorder is not a substitute protection mechanism and cannot stop/retract the junction.
